_comment: Carried over from 05293190AC by tools/port.py; do not edit by hand, edit the reference annotations and re-run.

units.spark: degrees BTDC = x / 2 (signed tables: two's complement)
units.pos256: position 0-255 along the rows (or columns) of a 3D table

0384.name: IacCoolantAdder
0384.desc: Idle air added against coolant in Sub_1AADC

039C.name: IacRunUpCoolant
039C.desc: IAC position in start mode once engine rpm reaches $2641, against coolant

03A8.name: IdleRpmSpeedTerm
03A8.desc: Value against rpm into $0DCF,Z (used by the PIT idle code)

03B4.name: FieldRampFactor
03B4.desc: Generator field soft start (Sub_08DD4): period factor against the step count $0DCC,Z (0-100), into $0DD0,Z

03C0.name: FlexCoolantWeight
03C0.desc: Flex-fuel: weight of FlexEthanolMap against coolant, used once Count3s has passed $0862

03CC.name: RpmFilterAboveIdle
03CC.desc: Filter weight of $09FC,Z (filtered rpm) against rpm above the idle target

03D8.name: PurgeMonitorLimit
03D8.desc: Purge monitor ($047A,Z bit 7): value $047B,Z against the purge command, at least $774F

0471.name: AcThrottleUpper
0471.desc: A/C throttle logic (Sub_2F06A), $0943,Z bit 7 clear: throttle at or above this value against vehicle speed sets bit 7

047D.name: AcThrottleLower
047D.desc: As AcThrottleUpper: throttle below this value sets bit 7 too

0489.name: AcThrottleUpperSet
0489.desc: $0943,Z bit 7 set: throttle at or above this value against vehicle speed keeps bit 7

0495.name: AcThrottleLowerSet
0495.desc: $0943,Z bit 7 set: throttle below this value keeps bit 7; otherwise bit 7 clears after the delay $04EE/$04EF ($0B53,Z)

04A7.name: BattTempSoakLimit
04A7.desc: Battery temperature model at start: coolant-minus-battery temperature limit against the engine-off time ($09C1,Z)

04B3.name: BattTempSoakAdder
04B3.desc: Battery temperature model at start: addition to $0194,Z against the engine-off time

04CC.name: BattTempHeatFactor
04CC.desc: Battery temperature model: factor on the excess above 110 against coolant (engine heat), into $0A5B,Z

050D.name: FanAcDelaySpeed
050D.desc: Fan with A/C: delay ($0B0C,Z) against vehicle speed while the A/C sensor is between $055C and $055D

0524.name: FanPwmStepCoolant
0524.desc: PWM fan (Sub_3A8D2): duty change against the coolant PD term ($0B19,Z, error to $05A2/$05A3 and rate)

053D.name: FanPwmStepAc
053D.desc: PWM fan (Sub_3AA44): duty change against the A/C sensor PD term ($0B1F,Z) with A/C requested

0551.name: FanPwmStepV09BF
0551.desc: PWM fan (Sub_3ABFE): duty change against the PD term of $09BF,Z ($0B2C,Z)

0583.name: ResetCoolantInit
0583.desc: At reset: $0C00,Z against start coolant temperature

05A0.name: EgrThrottleMax
05A0.desc: EGR enable: throttle limit against vehicle speed while EGR is on

05B2.name: EgrThrottleMaxOff
05B2.desc: As EgrThrottleMax while EGR is off (hysteresis)

05C4.name: EgrMapMinRpm
05C4.desc: EGR enable: MAP must be above this value against engine rpm (plus $0623 while off)

05E8.name: EgrStartDelayCoolant
05E8.desc: EGR delay after start ($0B33,Z) against start coolant temperature

060F.name: EgrFlowFilterVacuum
060F.desc: EGR flow estimate: filter weight against manifold vacuum (multiplied by rpm)

061B.name: EgrFeedForward
061B.desc: EGR valve: base PWM duty against the position target, added to the PID terms (output to PWMA)

0631.name: EgrPressureRatio
0631.desc: EGR flow estimate: factor against the ratio ($0684 − MAP)/(baro − MAP), into $0B37,Z

063D.name: EgrTarget
063D.desc: EGR valve position target ($0B3E,Z) against part-throttle MAP position (rows) and engine rpm (columns); EGR off below $035E

07DE.name: FlexLearnInit
07DE.desc: Flex-fuel learning: start value $01B5,Z against the ethanol value $01B4,Z

07EA.name: FlexLearnPurgeFactor
07EA.desc: Flex-fuel learning: factor $0F1D,Z against the purge ramp $042C,Z

07FE.name: FlexLearnTimeGain2
07FE.desc: Flex-fuel learning: second gain $0F21,Z against the learning time

080A.name: FlexLearnTimeGain
080A.desc: Flex-fuel learning: gain $0F20,Z against the learning time ($01A0,Z / 2, at most 255)

0816.name: FlexLearnStartCoolant
0816.desc: Flex-fuel learning: value $0F24,Z against start coolant temperature

082E.name: FlexLearnLevelFactor
082E.desc: Flex-fuel learning: value $0F26,Z against $019C,Z (probably fuel level)

0842.name: FlexLearnTrimWeight
0842.desc: Flex-fuel learning: weight $0F2B,Z against the size of the short-term trim

084E.name: FlexLearnLimitV006B2
084E.desc: Flex-fuel learning: limit $0F40,Z against $6B,Z, compared with $01B5,Z

0866.name: CrankEthanolScale
0866.desc: Cranking: flex-fuel ethanol content to row position of CrankEthanolCoolant

0A12.name: WotMapScale
0A12.desc: MAP to row position of the WOT spark and fuel tables

088A.name: FlexEthanolScale
088A.desc: Flex-fuel: ethanol content ($0198,Z) to the scaled value $0A91,Z used as table input

0896.name: RpmCurveV0C4A
0896.desc: Engine rpm (high byte) to $0C4A,Z; all points 255 in the reference image

08A2.name: DecelMapScale
08A2.desc: Corrected MAP to row position of DecelMapRpmLimit

08AE.name: AfterStartTimeScale
08AE.desc: Time since start ($07E6,Z, counted every 32 main-loop passes) to row position of AfterStartDecay

0A66.name: WarmupMapScaleLowSpeed
0A66.desc: MAP to row position of WarmupMapCoolantLowSpeed

0A5A.name: WarmupMapScale
0A5A.desc: MAP to row position of WarmupMapCoolant

08DA.name: WarmupRpmScaleIdle
08DA.desc: Rpm to row position of WarmupRpmCoolantIdle

08E6.name: IdleEnrichEthanolScale
08E6.desc: Flex-fuel ethanol content to row position of IdleEnrichEthanolAirTemp

08F2.name: TipInThrottleIndex
08F2.desc: Tip-in enrichment: throttle opening to row index 1-9 of TipInMatrix

0906.name: TipInRateIndex
0906.desc: Tip-in enrichment: throttle opening step to column index 1-9 of TipInMatrix

091A.name: DecelLeanRpmScale
091A.desc: Deceleration enleanment: rpm to row position of DecelLeanAirflow

0926.name: DecelLeanThrottleScale
0926.desc: Deceleration enleanment: throttle opening to column position of DecelLeanAirflow

0932.name: DecelLeanTimeScale
0932.desc: Deceleration enleanment: time since start to row position of DecelLeanTimeCoolant

093E.name: IacFuelScale
093E.desc: Extra idle air ($031B,Z minus $18,Z) to row position of IacFuelCoolant

094A.name: PurgeFuelMapScale
094A.desc: Purge vapor fuel correction: MAP to row position of PurgeFuelBase

0954.name: PurgeFuelRpm
0954.desc: Purge vapor fuel correction: engine rpm to column position of PurgeFuelBase

095E.name: CoolantSparkMapScale
095E.desc: MAP to row position of CoolantSparkMap

09A6.name: IdleBattTempScale
09A6.desc: Battery temperature to row position of IdleBattTempTarget

09B2.name: IacRollThrottleScale
09B2.desc: IAC target while rolling: throttle opening to row position of IacRollThrottleRpm

09BE.name: IacCoastSpeedScale
09BE.desc: Vehicle speed to row position of IacCoastSpeedRpm

09CA.name: IacFieldDutyScale
09CA.desc: Filtered duty of the CS2 input $106E.5 (probably the generator field) to row position of IacFieldDutyRpm

09D6.name: IacBaroScale
09D6.desc: Barometric pressure to row position of IacBaseBaroTarget and IacBaseBaroTarget2

0A83.name: CrankPulseCoolantFactor
0A83.desc: Factor on the cranking pulse against the cranking coolant, result into $076B,Z

0A8F.name: CrankBasePulse
0A8F.desc: Cranking base pulse width: ethanol content ($0A91,Z, rows) x cranking coolant temperature (columns); squared, then reduced by the decay factors below; into $0766,Z

0AEC.name: CrankRpmDecay
0AEC.desc: Cranking pulse reduction against rpm, throttle not closed; weighted by CrankRpmDecayWeight

0AF6.name: CrankRpmDecayClosed
0AF6.desc: Cranking pulse reduction against rpm with the throttle closed

0B00.name: CrankRpmDecayWeight
0B00.desc: Weight of the rpm reduction against the cranking coolant

0B0C.name: CrankV0769Decay
0B0C.desc: Cranking pulse reduction against $0769,Z; weighted by CrankV0769DecayWeight

0B18.name: CrankV0769DecayWeight
0B18.desc: Weight of CrankV0769Decay against the cranking coolant

0B24.name: CrankCoolantAdder2
0B24.desc: Cranking pulse addition against the cranking coolant, used while $0A5A,Z is not above the raw MAP

0B2E.name: CrankBaroDecay
0B2E.desc: Cranking pulse reduction against barometric pressure; weighted by CrankBaroDecayWeight

0B36.name: CrankBaroDecayWeight
0B36.desc: Weight of CrankBaroDecay against the cranking coolant

0B3E.name: CrankVacuumFactor
0B3E.desc: Cranking pulse factor against manifold vacuum

0B4A.name: CrankEthanolCoolant
0B4A.desc: Cranking: value against ethanol content and coolant into $0765,Z

0B6B.name: CrankCoolantAdder
0B6B.desc: Cranking: added to the coolant temperature against the number of crank events ($0C44,Z), limited to $0B75; result is the cranking coolant $0768,Z

0B74.name: InjectorDeadTime
0B74.desc: Injector dead time against battery voltage

0BDC.name: HotEngineEnrich
0BDC.desc: Enrichment against coolant above $0BD9 (with rpm, MAP and time above their limits), into $0811,Z; sets $0770,Z bit 1

0BEA.name: InjectionModeRpmFactor
0BEA.desc: Factor against rpm on the bank pulse ($0780,Z / $0782,Z) during the change of injection mode in Sub_112A8

1281.name: PartThrottleFuel
1281.desc: Part-throttle fuel correction on the MAP-based pulse width

0E5E.name: PartThrottleFuelMain
0E5E.desc: 17 x 17 fuel correction, MAP x rpm, used by the main-loop fuel calculation (Sub_10F1C) and by Sys39686; PartThrottleFuel is the per-event one

10C8.name: MapBaroOffset
10C8.desc: Added to MAP against barometric pressure before the part-throttle MAP scale (main-loop fuel, Sys39686, diagnostics)

1DFB.name: FuelAirTempCorr
1DFB.desc: Fuel multiplier against intake air temperature (scaled by the rpm and MAP weights)

1E3C.name: FuelAirTempMapWeight
1E3C.desc: Weight of the air-temperature fuel correction against MAP

1E24.name: FuelAirTempRpmWeight
1E24.desc: Weight of the air-temperature fuel correction against rpm

10FC.name: DecelBaroMapOffset
10FC.desc: Added to MAP against barometric pressure before DecelMapScale

1260.name: FuelEventRpmAdder
1260.desc: Pulse width added against rpm while $0D02,Z bit 7 is set (result x 8)

1277.name: WotTimeEnrichMax
1277.desc: Maximum of the WOT enrichment that builds up after a sustained WOT ($07AA,Z), against rpm

132E.name: WotFuel
132E.desc: Wide-open-throttle fuel correction on the MAP-based pulse width

13DD.name: WarmupCoolantAdder
13DD.desc: Warm-up enrichment against coolant, used instead of the tables while $0C30,Z bit 6 is set

13EF.name: AfterStartDecay
13EF.desc: After-start enrichment against time since start (rows) and $0768,Z (columns, set by the cranking code); part of the warm-up factor

144D.name: WarmupRpmFactor
144D.desc: Factor on the warm-up enrichment against rpm

1457.name: WarmupRunTimeFactor
1457.desc: Factor on the warm-up enrichment against engine run time ($0E,Z) while it is short

14BC.name: WarmupMapCoolantLowSpeed
14BC.desc: Warm-up enrichment, MAP x coolant, used below the vehicle speed $10F8 (with hysteresis)

151A.name: WarmupRpmFactorIdle
151A.desc: Factor on the warm-up enrichment against rpm while $0C30,Z bit 7 is set

1581.name: WarmupMapCoolant
1581.desc: Warm-up enrichment, MAP x coolant (normal case)

15E1.name: WarmupIdleTimeFactor
15E1.desc: Factor on WarmupRpmCoolantIdle against $0C47,Z (a timer cleared by the throttle code)

15E9.name: WarmupRpmCoolantIdle
15E9.desc: Warm-up enrichment, rpm x coolant, used while $0C30,Z bit 7 is set; scaled by WarmupIdleTimeFactor

1646.name: WarmupBaroFactor
1646.desc: Factor on the warm-up enrichment against barometric pressure

1652.name: BaroFuel
1652.desc: Pulse width added to the fuel pulse against barometric pressure (result x 8)

16A9.name: IdleEnrichSoakTime
16A9.desc: Idle enrichment against the engine-off time $017C,Z, into $07DE,Z

16B7.name: IdleEnrichRunTime
16B7.desc: Idle enrichment against run time ($07D9,Z); with the others into $07DA,Z, which multiplies the fuel while $0770,Z bit 3 is set (low rpm and MAP)

16C5.name: IdleEnrichEthanolAirTemp
16C5.desc: Idle enrichment against ethanol content (rows) and intake air temperature at start ($0803,Z)

172F.name: FlexEthanolFactor
172F.desc: Flex-fuel: factor against ethanol content ($0198,Z) into $0F02,Z, multiplied into FlexFuelFactor

173B.name: FlexEthanolRpm
173B.desc: Flex-fuel: value against ethanol content (rows) and $0C4A,Z (columns, from CalcEngineRpm), both as positions, into $0F06,Z

17D7.name: FlexEthanolCoolantFactor2
17D7.desc: Flex-fuel: factor against ethanol content and coolant into $0F03,Z; scales AfterStartDecay

1834.name: FlexEthanolCoolantFactor1
1834.desc: Flex-fuel: factor against ethanol content ($0A91,Z, rows) and coolant, into $0F04,Z, multiplied into FlexFuelFactor

1891.name: FlexEthanolCoolantFactor3
1891.desc: Flex-fuel: value against ethanol content and coolant into $0F05,Z

1901.name: FlexLearnBlend
1901.desc: Flex-fuel learning: blend weight of the new ethanol value against the learning time ($01A0,Z / 4), $01AC,Z bit 4 set

191A.name: ThrottleCloseMapOffset
191A.desc: On throttle closing: offset subtracted from MAP into MapLast against coolant

1924.name: AccelMapCoolant2
1924.desc: MAP-rate acceleration enrichment term against coolant into $07D5,Z

1930.name: AccelMapGainCoolant
1930.desc: MAP-rate acceleration enrichment gain against coolant, plus AccelMapGainAdder, into $07D4,Z

193C.name: MapFilterRiseCoolant
193C.desc: Filter coefficient for MapLast ($0A7F,Z) while MAP rises, against coolant at start, minus MapFilterRiseV0474

1948.name: AccelMapBaro
1948.desc: MAP-rate acceleration enrichment term against barometric pressure into $07D6,Z

1955.name: AccelTpsRateLimit
1955.desc: Throttle-rate acceleration enrichment: the throttle step above $14B5 is limited to this value, against coolant

1961.name: AccelTpsCoolantFactor
1961.desc: Throttle-rate acceleration enrichment: amount per throttle step against coolant; product into $07CA,Z

196D.name: TpsFilterRiseCoolant
196D.desc: Filter coefficient for ThrottleLast ($0A73,Z) while the throttle opens, against coolant at start

1979.name: AccelTpsBaro
1979.desc: Throttle-rate acceleration enrichment term against barometric pressure into $07D7,Z

1991.name: AccelRpmFactor
1991.desc: Acceleration enrichment factor against rpm; plus AccelMapAdder, limited to 1.0, into $07D0,Z

199F.name: ResetCoolantFuelInit
199F.desc: At reset: $07C4,Z (cranking fuel set-up) against coolant

19B6.name: TipInAirTempFactor
19B6.desc: Tip-in enrichment factor against intake air temperature

19C0.name: TipInBaroFactor
19C0.desc: Tip-in enrichment factor against barometric pressure; result (with ReturnlessFuelScale) into $07C6,Z and spread over the next injectors

1A2B.name: DecelLeanThrottleCoolantFactor
1A2B.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor on the throttle-closing term against coolant at start, into $07C0,Z

1A3D.name: DecelLeanMapCoolantFactor
1A3D.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor on the MAP-drop term against coolant at start, into $07BF,Z

1A4F.name: MapFilterFallCoolant
1A4F.desc: Filter coefficient for MapLast ($0A7F,Z) while MAP falls, against coolant at start

1A57.name: TpsFilterFallCoolant
1A57.desc: Filter coefficient for ThrottleLast ($0A73,Z) while the throttle closes, against coolant at start

1A69.name: DecelLeanBaroFactor
1A69.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor against barometric pressure; the result, limited by $158A, is $07C2,Z

1A75.name: DecelLeanMapAdder
1A75.desc: Deceleration enleanment: added to DecelLeanRpmFactor against MAP

1A89.name: DecelLeanRpmFactor
1A89.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor against rpm (with DecelLeanMapAdder)

1A9D.name: DecelLeanAirflow
1A9D.desc: Deceleration enleanment: airflow value against rpm and throttle position; the drop between last and current throttle goes to $0804,Z

1B3D.name: DecelLeanTimeCoolant
1B3D.desc: Deceleration enleanment shortly after start: time x coolant at start, into $07C1,Z

1B9A.name: IacFuelCoolantLimit
1B9A.desc: Above this (against coolant) the extra idle air ($031B,Z minus $18,Z) sets FuelModeFlags bit 7 instead of adding fuel

1BA4.name: EventFuelCoolantSub
1BA4.desc: Per-event fuel: amount subtracted from FuelPulseAdder against coolant while FuelModeFlags bit 7 is set

1BAE.name: IacFuelCoolant
1BAE.desc: Fuel pulse added for extra idle air, rows by IacFuelScale, columns coolant; x 16 into $080C,Z

1BEB.name: O2StartDelayCoolant
1BEB.desc: Closed-loop entry (Sub_14740): delay against coolant (plus $323D with an O2 fault flag)

1C2E.name: O2PurgeLimit
1C2E.desc: Closed loop: limit of $0752,Z against the purge ramp $042C,Z

1C51.name: O2VoltageScale
1C51.desc: Upstream O2 sensor ADC counts to the value used by closed loop and its monitor

1C61.name: O2VoltageScale2
1C61.desc: Second copy of the O2 voltage scale (same values as O2VoltageScale)

1D9E.name: O2StepScale
1D9E.desc: Closed loop: trim step against the size of the O2 error $F3,Z (doubled while purge is active and duty is zero)

1DAA.name: TrimUpperLimitRpm
1DAA.desc: Upper limit of the short-term fuel trim against rpm (signed)

1DB6.name: TrimLowerLimitRpm
1DB6.desc: Lower limit of the short-term fuel trim against rpm (signed)

1E18.name: FuelTrimAdjust
1E18.desc: Signed fuel adjustment (centred on 128) from calibration $1923 or, with $0C33,Z bit 4 clear, from $0ACA,Z (set over the SCI line); enabled by calibration bit $032C.7

1E30.name: FuelTrimAdjustMapWeight
1E30.desc: Weight of FuelTrimAdjust against MAP; the product goes to $07EE,Z and multiplies the fuel

1E6D.name: DecelCutRpmFactor
1E6D.desc: Factor on the fuel pulse while the deceleration cut-off flag ($0770,Z bit 7) is set, against rpm above the idle target

1F1F.name: PurgeFlowScale
1F1F.desc: Purge command (or constant $3048) to row position of PurgeFlow

1F33.name: PurgeCommandBase
1F33.desc: Purge command base against the purge ramp $042C,Z, into $F0,Z (then scaled by learning and vacuum, into $042E,Z)

1F3F.name: PurgeCommandVacuum
1F3F.desc: Factor on the purge command against manifold vacuum

1F4D.name: PurgeDutyPart
1F4D.desc: Purge solenoid duty ($0431,Z) against the purge command, part throttle

1F75.name: PurgeDutyAlt
1F75.desc: As PurgeDutyPart with calibration bits $0339.2/$0339.3 (by ThrottleState bit 0)

1F87.name: PurgeFlow
1F87.desc: Purge flow estimate ($047F,Z) against purge command position (rows) and manifold vacuum (columns)

2001.name: PurgeLearnUpClosed
2001.desc: Purge vapor learning, closed throttle: step added to $07EB,Z when the trim is above $1B2C

200D.name: PurgeLearnDownClosed
200D.desc: Purge vapor learning, closed throttle: step subtracted from $07EB,Z when the trim is below −$1B2D

2019.name: PurgeLearnUpPart
2019.desc: Purge vapor learning, part throttle: step added to $07EA,Z when the short-term trim is above $1B2C

2025.name: PurgeLearnDownPart
2025.desc: Purge vapor learning, part throttle: step subtracted from $07EA,Z when the trim is below −$1B2D

2031.name: PurgeFuelBase
2031.desc: Purge vapor fuel correction base against MAP (rows) and rpm (columns, normalised lookup); multiplied by the learned vapor value $07EB,Z

209F.name: AfterStartSparkMin
209F.desc: Lower limit of the spark change against time since start ($0D18,Z), into $04FC,Z

20A9.name: AfterStartSparkCap
20A9.desc: Upper limit of the spark change against time since start while $0D02,Z bit 3 is set (coolant above $1BED, baro, $0ABE,Z window)

2334.name: EgrSpark
2334.desc: Spark addition with EGR active ($0B30,Z bit 1): part-throttle MAP position (rows) and engine rpm (columns); scaled by $0B35,Z with calibration bit $0335.2

2523.name: AirTempSparkFactor
2523.desc: Weight of AirTempSparkMapRpm against intake air temperature (or $0A5A,Z with calibration bit $0330.5 clear)

25A5.name: AfterStartSparkCoolant
25A5.desc: Spark change after start against the coolant temperature at start, into $0D1B,Z

25C7.name: AfterStartSparkMapRpm
25C7.desc: Spark change after start, MAP x rpm (signed), weighted by AfterStartSparkCoolantWeight

2681.name: BaroSpark
2681.desc: Spark change against barometric pressure, weighted by BaroSparkRpmWeight

2691.name: DecelSpark
2691.desc: Spark change against the deceleration fuel factor (DecelFuelFactor), signed

269F.name: HighSpeedSparkRpm
269F.desc: Spark retard against engine rpm above coarse vehicle speed $1FA6 (hysteresis $1FA5)

2828.name: EventSparkThrottle
2828.desc: Upper limit of the event spark $0859,Z against throttle while $0856,Z bits 4 and 2 are set (raised by $205D per loop)

2832.name: EventSparkThrottle2
2832.desc: As EventSparkThrottle while $0856,Z bit 3 is set (raised by $205E per loop)

2847.name: SpeedRpmRef
2847.desc: Low-speed surge spark control (Sub_1DC20): expected rpm/128 against vehicle speed ($0A46,Z bit 0 set)

287F.name: SpeedDampP
287F.desc: Low-speed surge spark control: spark against the rpm deviation from SpeedRpmRef (sign kept)

2889.name: SpeedDampD
2889.desc: Low-speed surge spark control: spark against the change of the rpm deviation

2893.name: SpeedDampI
2893.desc: Low-speed surge spark control: spark against the accumulated rpm deviation

28AA.name: TipInRetardDuration
28AA.desc: Tip-in spark retard near idle (Sub_1D5EC): number of steps ($0D14,Z) against air temperature

28B2.name: TipInRetard
28B2.desc: Tip-in spark retard against air temperature (rows) and throttle rise above its filtered value $0D15,Z (columns)

28E4.name: TipInRetardKnock
28E4.desc: As TipInRetard while a knock retard is applied

2905.name: TipInRetardDurationKnock
2905.desc: As TipInRetardDuration while a knock retard is applied ($0D04,Z non-zero)

290D.name: TipInRetardAirScale
290D.desc: Tip-in spark retard: air temperature to row position

2970.name: SurgeRetardBase
2970.desc: Driveline surge spark control: base retard ($0D32,Z) against MAP position (rows) and the fast segment rpm $0D1E,Z (columns)

2CE3.name: KnockMapThresholdRpm
2CE3.desc: MAP above which knock control runs ($0DA4,Z), against engine rpm; multiplied by KnockMapThresholdBaro

2CF1.name: KnockMapThresholdBaro
2CF1.desc: Factor on the knock MAP threshold against barometric pressure

2CFB.name: KnockNoiseLearnWeight
2CFB.desc: Filter weight of the learned knock noise level per rpm band ($0DA5,Z)

2D07.name: KnockNoiseMin
2D07.desc: Lower limit of the learned knock noise level against engine rpm

2D13.name: KnockNoiseMax
2D13.desc: Upper limit of the learned knock noise level against engine rpm

2D1F.name: KnockWindowRpm
2D1F.desc: Knock sampling window length factor ($0DB5,Z) against engine rpm

2D35.name: KnockThreshold
2D35.desc: Knock sensor voltage threshold against rpm

2D49.name: KnockRetardStep
2D49.desc: Knock retard step against the knock signal above the threshold ($0A8B,Z minus KnockThresholdNow)

2D55.name: KnockRetardMaxMap
2D55.desc: Maximum knock retard ($0DAA,Z) against MAP (above throttle $24A5 or below rpm $24A6)

2E4D.name: KnockRetardMaxRpm
2E4D.desc: Limit of the per-cylinder knock retard ($0D40,Z) against engine rpm

2E8D.name: SparkCoolantCorrA
2E8D.desc: Spark correction against coolant temperature (one of two variants, chosen by the caller)

2E97.name: SparkCoolantCorrB
2E97.desc: Spark correction against coolant temperature (second variant)

2EA6.name: O2SparkTrimPos
2EA6.desc: Spark change against the short-term trim above its average (closed loop, part throttle), into $0D42,Z

2EB4.name: O2SparkTrimNeg
2EB4.desc: Spark change against the short-term trim below its average

2EE4.name: IdleSparkFilterCoolant
2EE4.desc: Idle spark control: filter weight of the rpm error against coolant

2EEC.name: IdleSparkRpmError
